|colspan="6" align="left"|<small>'''Notes:'''</small><br />
{{refbegin}}
{{note|ambassador|<small>1</small>}} <small>At the ambassador's meeting, Freddy and Florence had to decide on a castaway to eliminate. They couldn't come up with a<br />castaway, which ended with a rock drawing, eliminating Florence.</small><br />
{{note|idol|<small>2</small>}} <small>A Hidden Immunity Necklace was played, negating all votes against its user.</small><br />
{{note|elim|<small>3</small>}} <small>For coming in last at the immunity challenge, Martin was eliminated.</small><br />
{{note|duel|<small>4</small>}} <small>On Day 19, a duel occurred between Martin and Teheiura to reenter the game. Martin won and reentered the game.</small><br />
{{note|final4|<small>5</small>}} <small>At the final four, the remaining castaways competed in an elimination challenge. Moundir came in last and was eliminated.</small><br />
{{refend}}
